content:
As previously mentioned in #general > #grind_lint and scoped annotations, the #grind_lint command has some limitations for scoped annotations. I am not particularly fond of the solution discussed there, because opening all scopes is not representative of the usage of these annotations.

Recently we had the idea to instead try out user-defined grind attributes in CSLib, with similar goals of encapsulating grind rules and some other advantages in ergonomics. Unfortunately this seems to have a similar issue of not immediately working with #grind_lint and there is no equivalent to open scoped as briefly discussed at #lean4 > Grind sets? (equivalent of simp sets for `grind`)

For the case of user-defined grind attributes, is there currently any workaround that I am missing? More generally, is it a reasonable enough request for #grind_lint to support non-default annotations that it would be worth filing an issue?
